locator.section: In vigilia Ascensionis; Lectio Epistolae beati Pauli Apostoli ad Ephesios; Ephes. 4,7–13

entries.claim: The Ascension Vigil prints the Ephesians 4:7–13 lesson, beginning Fratres: Unicuique nostrum data est gratia and ending in mensuram aetatis plenitudinis Christi. This is the complete ninety-four-word body also stored for Saints Simon and Jude. The printed heading identifies the lesson as Paul's Epistle to the Ephesians. This occurrence does not assign its performer or delivery.
The identified approved Benziger 1962 page prints the complete selected 94-word lesson literally, without an expanded conclusion.
